max_external_temperature_last_month_c.info: The maximum temperature recorded during previous month.

max_flow_last_month_m3h.info: The maximum flow recorded during the last month.

min_external_temperature_last_month_c.info: The lowest external temperature outside of the meter during the last month.

min_flow_temperature_last_month_c.info: The lowest water temperature during the last month.

target_m3.info: The volume recorded by this meter at the target date.

target_date.info: The target date. Usually the end of the previous billing period.

total_m3.info: The total media volume consumption recorded by this meter.

current_status.info: Status of meter. This field will go away use status instead.

time_bursting.info: Amount of time the meter has been bursting.

time_dry.info: Amount of time the meter has been dry.

time_leaking.info: Amount of time the meter has been leaking.

time_reversed.info: Amount of time the meter has been reversed.
